steps.content:
2:23 a.m., August 19, N.F. 113
The Rust, near the DisSea radiation zone.
Along the edge of the Rust, a woman dressed entirely in black moves with haste, vanishing from one part of the void only to reappear in another instantaneously.
At last, she finds a sanctuary where her soul can rest.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: Ha... I've finally lost them...

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: The HUSH units from Paradeisos... from the West District to Eastside, they've been hindering us, as if they've got us figured out... The one pulling the strings is that Sinner, <color=#fb9259>Shalom</color>...

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: I'm in deep trouble now...
The woman in black leans silently against the wall, her wounds severe and leaving her too drained to keep running.
Reinforcements aren't coming—that's just the way they operate. Field agents like her work alone on the Overground, each carrying the weight of their own life and death.
It's their only way to stand against Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: While we're cautiously mining power little by little from external sources, Paradeisos has already penetrated deep into the heart of Mania—reaching at least the 8th level of <color=#fb9259>Collective Observation</color>.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: No... they can't possibly harness such profound power yet. If they could, the game would already be over; we'd have no chance of winning.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: Right now, they're just observing and communicating. They were able to make such precise manipulations in March because they've noticed fluctuations in the collective will within the <color=#fb9259>world of Mania</color>. As for ten years ago, the mission across the DisSea was also directly overseen by Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: But even observation has its limits... No matter the technique used, an <color=#fb9259>Observer</color> is bound to be corroded over time. This means Paradeisos must have <color=#fb9259>backup</color> Observers on hand. Have they really advanced their technology to this extent?

If all this is part of the Hush's grand scheme, derived from her observations, and if she has indeed penetrated the depths of Mania... then what she might see or do is beyond any comprehension from the Underground.
What sort of technology does Paradeisos have to keep such a monster under control? And could this technology be effective on ****?
The thought sends a shiver down the woman in black. Fear and loathing well up inside her.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: At all costs... they must be stopped, must be eradicated... <color=#fb9259>Hush X</color>, Shalom... Otherwise, BR-002 will...
As she wrestles with her thoughts, a voice she knows all too well pierces the darkness.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh, my. Segal, is that you? Long time no see. You look like you've been through the wringer.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Don't die; my Garden still relies on your little tricks to stay hidden.

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: Heh... The power isn't mine; it's from the Underground, and now it's yours alone.

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: I honored your terms and paid you upfront, but as it stands... you've failed to fulfill your end of the bargain.

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: Worse yet... you've compromised us all.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Is that so? Well, I am... truly... sorry.
Coquelic steps forward, closing in on Segal. With a swift move, she plunges her hand into Segal's wound.

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: Cough!!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It was you who tricked Garofano, wasn't it... Fed her deadly misinformation, along with those vile runes.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You seek my aid instead of turning to your fellow beings from the Underground—clearly, you've been cast aside.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You've always been our sole point of contact. With your departure, the Garden stands to lose a significant client—a regrettable loss, indeed.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Thank you for your final patronage. From now on, my Garden will have no further ties with the Underground.

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: Cough... Hehe... Hehehehe...

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: You didn't have to betray me... Given your skills, defying the Underground would hardly put you in harm's way...

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: But it doesn't matter now... my mission is fulfilled...

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: I know why you did this... I know the sacrifices you made for this newfound power. I know why you betrayed me...

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhh!!

Before she can utter another word, Coquelic swings her hand, extracting an enormous, dark, and eerily writhing alien flower from within her. As this happens, Segal is transformed beyond recognition, leaving only the sinister bloom displayed against her black attire.
Coquelic observes the woman's form dissolving before her eyes and witnesses the nightmarish entity she has unleashed. This should have been done much sooner.
The one who cast Coquelic into the abyss, who has ensnared her for countless years, this lowly rat who dares to covet her Garden—has finally been banished to where she rightfully belongs.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Of course, because I wanted to.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Next...
She gazes intently at the intelligence concealed in the woman's embrace. And on the other side... another individual who presents even more of a challenge.

steps.speaker: Wriggling Flower Mud
steps.content: It's fine, go... I know you'll help me...
